create_kernel_ridge: create a KernelRidge estimator with configurable kernel, alpha, and kernel parameters
fit_kernel_ridge: fit a KernelRidge model on training data with optional sample weights and multi-target support
predict_kernel_ridge: predict target values using a fitted KernelRidge model with kernel matrix computation
compute_kernel_matrix: compute a pairwise kernel matrix using linear, rbf, polynomial, or precomputed kernels
get_kernel_ridge_tags: get sklearn tags for a KernelRidge estimator including sparse and pairwise input flags
